primary_sources.title: Feedback-optimized parallel tempering Monte Carlo
primary_sources.method: Concentrate temperature density near replica-flow bottlenecks.

implementation: Regularized last-endpoint flow counts, monotone fractions, square-root interval masses and damped ladder moves, plus greedy quench/injection. An optimization adaptation, not a faithful equilibrium-sampling reproduction.
trigger: The 8-replica pilot had nearly zero middle-ladder exchange acceptance and no energy improvement.
exa_followup: Queued separately behind the serialized provider coordinator; not yet claimed as an Exa-driven experiment.
